responsibility: Option definition table for gccgo-specific command-line flags. It registers the Go language class and its options with GCC’s option-processing machinery, including package path/prefix controls, relative import handling, C header emission, runtime-compilation mode, embed configuration, frontend dump and optimization toggles, division-check controls, return-statement warning policy, and optimization/escape-analysis debugging variables, thereby defining the parsed option set and backing global variables used by `go-lang.cc` and the Go frontend.
